SELECT timestamp,tenant_id,agent_id,workflow_id,operation,resource_category,decision,reason_codes,controls,injection_risk,task_alignment,policy_revision,threat_feed_revision,credits,latency,trace_id FROM aicl_security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('__all__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR tenant_id IN (${tenant:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent_id IN (${agent:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) OR workflow_id IN (${workflow:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${operation:sqlstring}) OR operation IN (${operation:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${decision:sqlstring}) OR decision IN (${decision:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${tool:sqlstring}) OR tool IN (${tool:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${semantic_status:sqlstring}) OR semantic_status IN (${semantic_status:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${policy_revision:sqlstring}) OR policy_revision IN (${policy_revision:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${threat_feed_revision:sqlstring}) OR threat_feed_revision IN (${threat_feed_revision:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${control:sqlstring}) OR controls && ARRAY[${control:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND ('__all__' IN (${reason_code:sqlstring}) OR reason_codes && ARRAY[${reason_code:sqlstring}]::text[]) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT timestamp,decision,trace_id FROM aicl_security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('__all__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR tenant_id IN (${tenant:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent_id IN (${agent:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) OR workflow_id IN (${workflow:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${operation:sqlstring}) OR operation IN (${operation:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${decision:sqlstring}) OR decision IN (${decision:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${tool:sqlstring}) OR tool IN (${tool:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${semantic_status:sqlstring}) OR semantic_status IN (${semantic_status:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${policy_revision:sqlstring}) OR policy_revision IN (${policy_revision:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${threat_feed_revision:sqlstring}) OR threat_feed_revision IN (${threat_feed_revision:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${control:sqlstring}) OR controls && ARRAY[${control:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND ('__all__' IN (${reason_code:sqlstring}) OR reason_codes && ARRAY[${reason_code:sqlstring}]::text[]) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
